title: Research: save 108 R420 XORs with restored frame-zero sharing (no new kappa)
body:
This finite bit-circuit contribution factors helpers 552 and 521 in PR543's frame-zero dirt compensation. It saves **108 binary XORs**, including both preparation and restoration: **26,916 -> 26,808 native ADDs**. Both dirty helpers are restored before phase A. **Status: research contribution / finite circuit improvement; no new kappa.**

The complete MOVE/COPY/ERASE subsequence, 420 helpers, nine copies, rank mass 5,112 and both measured native positive-prefix bounds remain unchanged. The pair census covers all 87,990 helper pairs by two methods; 108 is maximal only within this specified single-pair recipe on the fixed D matrix.

The interface change is explicit: the original H2 forbids helper destinations in D. This package proves and checks the sufficient replacement that D has the same aggregate `(x,s,y) -> (x,s,y+Ns)` map and restores every helper before A. The stock H2 and literal K check reject the compressed representation as expected; exact normalization and actual candidate replay validate the stated finite extension. No predecessor checker is patched.

```sh
python3 -B research/r420-frame-zero-pair/verify.py
```

Expected: `PASS_R420_FRAME_ZERO_PAIR D=19922->19814 native_adds=26916->26808 columns=660 kappa=unchanged`.

Requires Python 3.11+, C++17 and Boost headers; Python dependencies are standard library only. Passed locally with Python 3.13.7, GCC 15.2 and Boost 1.88:

- Exact E8/frame audit, all 660 dirty-input columns, independent set-valued D and raw-record interpreters.
- Unmodified C++ legality and nine-stage replay: 1,380 columns and 18 omitted-bridge controls per word.
- Six D rejection controls, a positive control, and an F2-neutral record control rejected specifically by the positive-prefix guard.
- Normal and optimized Python, complete exact-certificate comparison, output-overwrite protection, and `make selected-record-check`.
- Isolated reproduction from a Git archive containing only this contribution and its nine declared source files.

Exact base: `66849e1475c930fd7732b1a0067ffee7e1e95f60`. Reviewed PR543 source: `2065fe4f72a914d907f1046603f5a36f17018535`. Source pins, circuit recipe, exact certificate, proof, search scope, validation and local seed-1 claim are included under `research/r420-frame-zero-pair/`. No existing file, `upstream/` content or selected-frontier pointer changes.

Final overlap refresh through #685: #670 and #674 change separate phase-B blocks; #661 fixes D and excludes circuit changes; #673 and #677 concern different dirty primitives. Their work is credited and not imported. No pinned coordination issue exists.

The hosted-parent reconstruction, invoice and changed-word outer assembly remain integration obligations, together with review of generalized D under the retained all-size/common-label interface. The selected composition is complex-limited. Repository-wide `make verify`, Lean and remote CI are not claimed. This is not a proof of the full multiplication theorem.

Credit: eumemic's PR543/493 construction and checker; Dylan Crow, DaysSky, Chafik Boukhalfa, Zhihao Chen, DreamingOfClouds and the cumulative predecessor lineage detailed in the README.
